column2: The competent authority shall have power—
to enter and inspect at all reasonable hours of the
day or night at any place in which workers in any
trade are employed, for the purpose of examining
any  register  or  for  ascertaining  whether  the
provisions of this Act are being complied with ; or
where no such register is available for examination
when  he  inspects  such  place,  to  require  the
production of such register on a specified later date
for examination at such place or at the office of such
authority ; or
to take copies of the whole or any part of any such
register ; or
to question any person whom he finds in such place
and whom he has reasonable cause to believe is an
employer of workers employed in any trade carried
on in such place ; or
to  direct,  in  writing,  any  employer  of  workers
employed in any trade to furnish him on or before a
specified date, with—
